title: Online Causal Configuration for Networked Systems via Doubly Robust Steady-State Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.09665v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Measurement exploration reveals how interacting local controllers behave but can alter the steady-state regime a network operator seeks to optimize. Exploratory rewards may therefore fail to identify a configuration's no-exploration value: under full exploration, identical logged distributions can conceal different target values. Identification requires accounting for both action-law mismatch and shifts in the steady-state context distribution. We introduce CAUSAL-UCB, which selects configurations using optimistic bounds on target causal values. translated_title: 基于双重稳健稳态学习的网络化系统在线因果配置
translated_abstract: 测量探索能够揭示相互作用的本地控制器的行为方式，但可能会改变网络运营商所寻求优化的稳态状态。因此，探索性奖励可能无法识别某一配置在无探索情况下的真实价值：在完全探索条件下，相同的记录分布可能掩盖不同的目标值。识别需要同时考虑行动规律的不匹配以及稳态上下文分布的偏移。我们提出了CAUSAL-UCB算法，它使用目标因果值的乐观界限来选择配置。其干扰感知的裁剪双重稳健评估器产生决策前证书，将统计波动与经过校准的识别、迁移和时间依赖性误差分离。对于任何有限时间范围和预先设定的测量探索率时间表 $\{\eta_t\}$，我们证明了极小极大推理误差的 $\Omega((1+\sum_t\eta_t)^{-1/2})$ 下界以及遗憾下界。
tldr: 提出CAUSAL-UCB算法，通过干扰感知的裁剪双重稳健稳态学习方法，在测量探索会改变网络化系统稳态的困难条件下正确识别并在线优化配置的目标因果价值，并给出了推理误差与遗憾的理论下界。
en_tdlr: Proposes CAUSAL-UCB, an interference-aware clipped doubly robust steady-state learning algorithm that correctly identifies and optimizes the no-exploration causal value of configurations in networked systems despite exploration-induced steady-state shifts, with proven lower bounds on minimax inference error and regret.
